usedFor: Clearout checks email addresses with “Verify Email Address” and separate catch-all, disposable, business and role checks.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Verify Email Address” in Clearout
bestTemplate.why: A new booking carries an email address, and the action checks it before anyone writes to it.

watchOut: “Verify Email Address for CatchAll” is its own action, so choose the check that matches what you need.
